periods.time: Afternoon before the final and next day's ceremony
periods.label: 检验弟弟的烈风剑帝
titles: 七星剑武祭季军（天音失格后递补）

status.current: tests Ikki before leaving Osaka; receives third place by default but is absent from ceremony
status.condition: defeated by Stella in semifinal but still overwhelming in training

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother; tests whether Ikki's weak sword can face a dragon and finally offers all his techniques for Ikki to exploit.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Semifinal opponent who defeated him and whose strength he uses as the benchmark for Ikki.

periods.summary: Ouma appears at Ikki's training session despite Ikki having expected no reply. He declares that if Ikki's half-hearted power cannot face the dragon, he will break Ikki's dull sword before the final. His Amatsukaze, Tenryuu Gusoku, vacuum blades and Amaterasu overwhelm Ikki, but Ikki tricks him out of the ring and insists that his sword exists to win, not to look strong. Ouma accepts that this may be a form of strength and offers his full repertoire so Ikki can try to overturn fate. He later leaves Osaka before the ceremony despite being awarded third place by default after Amane's disqualification.

key_events.summary: Arrives as the most severe pre-finale test and helps Ikki stop fearing Stella.
Is named third place by default but does not attend.

periods.time: Immediately after crossing Eurasia to the former Rebellion headquarters
periods.label: 跨越昔日恐惧的烈风剑帝

status.current: escorts Tsukikage, Kazamatsuri, Rinna, Sara and Charlotte back toward Japan after Nango covers the retreat
status.condition: severely injured from Tatra base battle but mobile through pressure and willpower

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Rescues her at Charlotte's request after she is kidnapped by US forces.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Responds to her emergency call and follows her directions to the Tatra base.
relationships.abraham-carter: Discovers Abraham, not the Tyrant, was the enemy who once crushed him; defeats one clone with his completed wind sword before being suppressed by numbers.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Accepts Nango's order to retreat with the rescued captives while Nango holds the rear.
relationships.stella-vermillion: His previous duel with Stella erased the fear that once froze him before the Tyrant's power.

periods.summary: Ouma reaches the ruined Rebellion base seeking revenge on the Tyrant, but finds Charlotte hidden by Sara's magic and learns Rinna's group has been taken by the US military. He attacks the Tatra base alone, shelters Charlotte with wind camouflage, annihilates soldiers and tanks, and duels Abraham Carter. Learning that Abraham was the unseen enemy who once traumatized him, Ouma rejoices at the chance to surpass his old fear. After seeing Rinna and Sara's torture he abandons his self-imposed purity, devours the surrounding wind, completes Danzuki Tenryuusou: Shinuchi and cuts down one Abraham with Ippatsu no Kaze. He is then overwhelmed by dozens of clones until Nango arrives, after which he rescues the captives and carries them toward Japan.

key_events.summary: Finds Charlotte at the ruined base and agrees to rescue Rinna.
Defeats one Abraham Carter with a perfected wind sword but is then pinned by clone numbers.
Leaves the battlefield with the hostages under Nango's protection.
Carries the group toward Japan as Tsukikage collapses from prophetic nightmares.

periods.label: 烈风剑帝作为兄长与盾

status.condition: critically burned while shielding others, but survives

personality.summary: Ouma remains blunt, severe and strength-focused, yet his actions show responsibility toward his siblings and comrades. He pushes Ikki forward by refusing to let him confuse self-destruction with victory.
flaws: tends to frame care as challenge or criticism

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother; initially restrains him on Itsuki's order, later entrusts Stella's rescue to him and rebukes his despair.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister; fights alongside her and benefits from her final plan.
relationships.toka-todo: Fights with her against Abraham series, combining wind and lightning as godlike forces.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Protects him during the Abraham battle and later during the possessed Stella aftermath.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rescue target and later possessed threat; he shields the team from her Bahamut Soul.

periods.summary: Fresh from rescuing Prime Minister Tsukikage, Ouma joins Itsuki at Hagun and is ordered onto the Stella rescue team. He transports slower members with wind, blocks mercenary fire with Tenryu Kacchu, destroys fortifications and Large EDY units, and stays behind with Touka and Alice to fight Abraham clones while Ikki and Shizuku continue downward. Against the Abrahams he unleashes a strengthened Kusanagi/Shinuchi by gathering external wind. When possessed Stella uses Bahamut Soul, Ouma spends his wind armor protecting Alice and Touka rather than himself, leaving him gravely burned. Even then he stands and rebukes Ikki for giving up on victory, helping restore Ikki's resolve to save rather than kill Stella.

key_events.summary: Clears mercenaries and EDY units with wind techniques and brute force.
Stays on the fourth floor to fight Abraham clones so Ikki and Shizuku can advance.
Uses his wind armor to protect comrades from Stella's possessed Bahamut Soul.
Rebukes Ikki's self-destructive despair and insists no one has died yet.
